eventDetail.scope: The International Conference on Digital Economy and Fintech Innovation - DEFI2026 is an international event focused on the digital economy, fintech, and related fields, organized by Vietnam-Korea University of Information and Communication Technology (VKU) and and Asean Consortium for Innovation and Research (ACIR). The conference aims to provide a platform for global researchers and professionals to discuss advancements in finance technology, digital economy trends, financial strategies, and policy considerations. DEFI 2026 will foster valuable exchanges and stimulate new research on key issues in technology in finance, digital finance and fintech, encouraging innovative solutions to current challenges. The event will take place in Da Nang, Vietnam, in December 2026, attracting scholars, industry experts, policymakers worldwide. We believe publishing the DEFI 2026 conference proceedings in IEEE will contribute to the advancement of knowledge in digital economy and fintech.
